architecture: Ensemble: LightGBM 400 trees (leaves=64, lr=0.05) + HistGradientBoosting (200 iter, 63 leaves, lr=0.08), averaged probabilities
features: 38 raw + 48 engineered (log1p heavy-tail, bidirectional ratios, rates, missingness flags) = 86 columns
threshold_rationale: F1-protected knee: F1 0.9802 (baseline 0.9773) with cost 14,781 (42% below baseline @0.5); group-val agrees (F1 0.9835 @0.4)
cost_function: Cost = 20*FN + FP (default w=20; retune with run.py fit --save --w <W>)
training_data: shared/data/train.csv (1,524,028 rows, group-hash split for validation)
